the_dungeon.name: The Dungeon
the_dungeon.description: The Tower of Nexus, rising from the wound of the Shattering. Every kind of creature climbs its floors. Wave after wave, no two fights alike.

goblin_forest.name: Goblin Forest
goblin_forest.description: Tangled woods crawling with quick, cunning goblins. Watch for poison and bleeding blades.

troll_caves.name: Troll Caves
troll_caves.description: Frozen caverns where hulking trolls hit hard and shrug off blows.

orc_plains.name: Orc Plains
orc_plains.description: Open grasslands held by armored orc warbands. Rich in ore.

fairy_circles.name: Fairy Circles
fairy_circles.description: Enchanted glades where fairies weave wild magic. Expect spells, not swords.

_doc: region/place: where it lies on Nyxarys (data/regions.json); travel days are computed from the map distance to Nexus (travel_days is the fallback).
